### The Reason We Sing
Author: Emma Danzey
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-reason-we-sing-crosswalk-the-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 47:6
Points:
- Singing praises stems from childlike joy and delight in our Creator.
- Scripture repeatedly demonstrates singing as an act of worship, even during prison or battle.
- Believers are called to praise God as King even when weighed down by sorrow or difficult circumstances.
- Singing redirects our focus away from heavy emotions and anchors us in God's presence.
- United corporate singing acts as a public light and testimony to the gospel for others.

### The View from Here
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-august-30-2017.html
Passage: Psalm 47:2
Points:
- Reaching high vantage points reveals a grander view and puts our smallness into perspective.
- God is El Elyon, the Lord Most High and sovereign King over the entire earth.
- Earthly burdens and discouragement often drag our perspective downward into defeat.
- Connecting with God's high place requires intentional effort to lift our eyes and concerns to Him.
- Approaching the Lord in prayer and humility allows His mercy and strength to elevate our mindset.
